description.value: A community history museum in Shawnigan Lake highlighting the area's rich past, including the story of the Kinsol Trestle and the famous landscape painter E.J. Hughes. Located along the Shawnigan Lake-Mill Bay corridor, it features exhibits on local First Nations heritage, pioneer history, and the railway era. The museum also operates a gift shop and hosts school programs and community events.
